description: Diagnostic instrumentation only: local decoded-frame-to-dequeue timings, batch holds/composition, transport excess delay and socket writes, client event service and full pending-map timeout scans. One run/load, five-second offered window, four validators and oneclient,20msonewaydelay,durablegroup64requests/1ms,5sdeadline,maxinflight16384. Shared8-logical-CPU macOS host. Added timers/locks/samples have overhead; diagnostic results are not replacement capacity measurements. No deliberate concurrent builds/tests/profiling during these runs. Worker service totals and percentile samples do not decompose a single transaction critical path.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

interpretation: Dominant seconds-long queue is in client after response decoding, not in validator receive queues. Per-loop full pending-map timeout scans grow with outstanding transactions. Service totals alone had overemphasized validator journal I/O. Diagnostic timers perturb load behavior; do not replace uninstrumented throughput measurements. Phase round percentiles are conditional on observed phase completions, not censored population latencies. Response-transport snapshots on validators are taken before Stop response enqueue and can omit still-pending writes.
